first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A first-person person, with only purple-gloved hands and warm-brown forearms visible; after flipping Weapon A with the right hand, both hands come together to grip it.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A light-gold handgun handled by Person A, with a relatively long slide visible; the grip area is later occluded by both hands.

entities.name: white locker group with blue lettering
entities.identification: A row of off-white tall cabinets on the image-left side, with blue-gray handwritten graffiti on the cabinet doors and a darker cabinet side visible at the right end.

entities.name: industrial corridor observation window
entities.identification: A wide, large glass window with a gray frame on an indoor wall; the window surface is divided by a vertical center mullion, with a windowsill below.

entities.name: wet, shiny ground outside the window
entities.identification: The gray corridor floor visible through the observation window, with a wet, shiny appearance, strip-like reflections, and dark patches.

entities.name: industrial building outside the window
entities.identification: The clearly discernible industrial building on the image-right outside the window, with a dark-gray near wall, vertically ribbed metal cladding on the upper part, and wall-mounted pipes.

entities.name: light, bright sky outside the window
entities.identification: The light gray-white bright sky area in the image-upper-left of the building outside the window.

entities.name: square container outside the window
entities.identification: A gray upright box-like object farther away in the outdoor corridor, with a nearly square front outline visible.

entities.name: light-colored locker-room wall
entities.identification: The light-beige vertical wall panels surrounding the observation window, with warm-colored reflections on the surface.

entities.name: gray-brown locker-room floor
entities.identification: The gray-brown floor along the bottom edge of the indoor image, with a yellow boundary line.
